text: Which genes enhanced in plasma cells (single-cell) encode blood-secreted proteins that are not secreted in the digestive tract?
plan: Cell type category (scRNA): Plasma cells / Cell type enhanced AND Secretome annotation: Secreted to blood AND NOT Secretome annotation: Secreted to digestive system
understanding: The query asks for genes with enhanced expression in plasma cells based on single-cell RNA-seq, which encode proteins predicted to be secreted to blood, while excluding proteins predicted to be secreted to the digestive system.

trail.why: The requirement specifically asks for genes enhanced in plasma cells in single-cell RNA-seq data, matching cell type 'Plasma cells' and specificity category 'Cell type enhanced'.
The requirement specifically selects genes that encode proteins secreted into the blood.

trail.requirement: not secreted in the digestive tract
trail.why: The requirement specifies excluding genes secreted in the digestive tract, which directly corresponds to the 'Secreted to digestive system' secretome annotation.

requirements.why: Cell type category (scRNA) specifically assesses RNA specificity categories (such as enhanced) across single cell types including plasma cells, whereas Cell type enrichment (RNA) is restricted by tissue and Cell type group category (scRNA) is at the group level.
Secretome annotation classifies predicted secreted proteins by destination, including 'Secreted to blood'.

requirements.requirement: not secreted in the digestive tract
requirements.why: Secretome annotation includes the destination category 'Secreted to digestive system', which can be negated with the NOT operator to exclude these genes.
